channel.title: SPZ Twitter Feed - Field Content (JPost Fallback)
channel.description: תוכן מהשטח - אנטישמיות, איום איסלאמי, חשיפת תומכי טרור, פרו-ישראל | מקור: Jerusalem Post

item.title: [97] 📝 NYC antisemitic hate crimes 70% higher in May 2026 than May 2025, 41 incidents confirmed
item.description: So far in 2026, there have been 152 confirmed antisemitic hate crimes. There have been 17 confirmed hate crimes against Muslims, 9 against Asian people, and 18 against Black people.

item.title: [97] 📝 IDF, Shin Bet kill several Hamas General Security Apparatus officials in Gaza
item.description: The General Security Apparatus' responsibilities include maintaining communication and coordination between Hamas leaders, protecting them, and escorting them to emergency facilities.

item.title: [96] 📝 EU pledges €100M to Lebanese army to reinforce state against Hezbollah threat
item.description: Kaja Kallas announced the EU is giving €100M to Lebanon's military to reinforce its forces, empower institutions, and reduce Hezbollah's influence in the country.

item.title: [96] 📝 'No Jews in our hotel': Israeli family denied access to Bavarian hotel
item.description: A hotel in Bavaria barred an Israeli family with a 'no Jews allowed' message, prompting public backlash, an apology, and a police investigation.

item.title: [95] 📝 Capt. Eitan Shmuel Lemberg killed in combat in southern Lebanon
item.description: Lemberg was killed when a Hezbollah terrorist fired an anti-tank missile at an IDF tank north of the Litani River.

item.title: [95] 📝 Man wearing Star of David necklace beaten in possible antisemitic gang attack in Germany
item.description: Police are investigating whether the attack may have been motivated by antisemitism because the victim was wearing a Star of David necklace at the time of the suspected aggravated assault.

item.title: [95] 📝 Hezbollah rejects ceasefire after US announces ceasefire between Israel, Lebanon
item.description: Hezbollah's Naim Qassem warned northern Israel will not be safe as long as Lebanese villages are bombed and civilians continue to be killed.

item.title: [94] 📝 Iran's Quds Force chief Qaani demands Israel withdraw from Lebanon amid US-brokered deal
item.description: Iran's Quds Force chief Esmail Qaani demanded Israel withdraw from Lebanon, warning that supporting Hezbollah is a duty and stressing the region's ongoing tensions.

item.title: [94] 📝 Four more arrested for two drive-by gel pellet gun attacks on Toronto Jews
item.description: The incident was preceded a week before by an assault in which three identifiable Jewish residents were walking and were shot at with a gel pellet gun, inflicting minor injuries.

item.title: [94] 📝 Gov't allocates over NIS 1 billion to prosecute October 7 terrorists in military tribunals
item.description: Lawmakers likened it to the Eichmann trials in 1961, which broadcast live and recorded testimonies of Holocaust survivors throughout the world before the execution.

item.title: [93] 📝 'Jews are eating kids': Jewish woman choked, hair torn out in NYC subway attack
item.description: Jewish woman attacked in NYC subway, choked and had hair torn out in antisemitic assault.

item.title: [93] 📝 Hezbollah threatens to target Tel Aviv, Haifa, if Israel strikes again in Beirut
item.description: The deputy head of Hezbollah's political council stated that 'The equation of Dahiyeh against settlements in the north cannot be accepted in any way.'

item.title: [92] 📝 Two visibly Jewish men find 'Free Palestine' message on London hotel room TV
item.description: Two visibly Jewish men discovered a 'Free Palestine' message on their London hotel room TV in an apparent antisemitic incident.

item.title: [92] 📝 Knesset approves tax benefits for West Bank settlements amid opposition criticism
item.description: The Knesset approved a bill granting tax benefits to West Bank settlements, with Finance Minister Smotrich calling it recognition for residents living under a security threat.

item.title: [91] 📝 Iran demands frozen assets be released in initial phase of deal with US, leading to stalemate
item.description: The dispute has emerged as one of the central obstacles preventing progress toward a memorandum of understanding between Tehran and Washington.

item.title: [91] 📝 NHS urged to ban pro-Palestinian badges amid antisemitism concerns
item.description: Lord John Mann's review recommends that NHS staff receive mandatory antisemitism training and bans pro-Palestinian badges to ensure Jewish patients and staff feel safe.

item.title: [90] 📝 Iran's Supreme Leader warns of Israeli, US divisions threatening regime, undermining 'resilience'
item.description: Iran's Supreme Leader says Israel is trying to divide the country after a military setback, urging citizens to counter fear, mistrust, and despair with unity and vigilance.

item.title: [90] 📝 SJP political program calls to 'usurp' universities to 'weaken the US'
item.description: National Students for Justice in Palestine aims to reshape US universities, confront Zionism, and advance a Marxist-inspired program for political education.

item.title: [90] 📝 Ex-top Mossad official: Barnea led agency to unprecedented operational reach - interview
item.description: Former senior Mossad official Ilan Rom says Barnea's leadership expanded the agency's capabilities, allowing dozens of operations at once and boosting Israel's regional influence.

item.title: [90] 📝 NYU student charged with hate crime after flying swastika, Star of David flag over campus building
item.description: An NYU student is facing hate crime charges after allegedly raising a flag depicting a Star of David, two swastikas and the letters 'NYU' over a university building.

item.title: [89] 📝 Zack Polanski signs letter calling for investigation, screening of IDF vets with UK citizenship
item.description: Polanski joined British politicians and activists urging the UK government to probe IDF veterans and implement airport screening for potential war crimes.

item.title: [89] 📝 Trump says US will not return to war against Iran unless American troops are killed - report
item.description: The report came just after Netanyahu told CNBC that the US and Israel would resume military action against Iran if needed.

item.title: [88] 📝 New York Jews wake up at the Israel Day Parade - opinion
item.description: Mayor Mamdani's absence from a long-standing civic celebration left many Diaspora Jews feeling newly exposed in the city with the world's largest Jewish population.

item.title: [88] 📝 Israeli businessman 'King of Slot Machines' Tony Bargig murdered in Prague
item.description: Bargig, 54, had been living and working in Prague for several years and had owned several gambling businesses.

item.title: [87] 📝 Netanyahu appoints Guy Markizeno as military secretary after Mossad reshuffle
item.description: Markizeno currently serves as Defense Minister Israel Katz's military secretary.

item.title: [87] 📝 Protesters' attack on Supreme Court vice president 'crosses red line,' Isaac Amit says
item.description: 'This crosses a red line, behavior far beyond the bounds of legitimate protest, and is an attempt to undermine the sense of security of judicial officeholders and their families.'

item.title: [86] 📝 Bamba blankets NYC after Park Slope Food Coop vote to boycott Israeli products
item.description: Four thousand free bags of the Israeli peanut butter-flavored snack made their way Sunday along the Celebrate Israel Day Parade route up Fifth Avenue.

item.title: [86] 📝 Iraq PM hosts Iranian-backed militias to push disarmament, consolidate state control
item.description: Iraq's Prime Minister Ali al Zaidi met Iranian-backed militias to push them to disarm and join state command, aiming to limit armed group influence while avoiding conflict.

item.title: [85] 📝 More than 300 cities across US officially recognize Jewish American Heritage Month in May
item.description: The growing momentum reflects a shared commitment to celebrate Jewish heritage, confront rising antisemitism, and reaffirm the fundamental values that define American identity.

item.title: [85] 📝 Why one non-Jewish woman moved to Israel amid rising antisemitism - interview
item.description: Interview with a non-Jewish woman who moved to Israel amid rising antisemitism worldwide.

item.title: [80] 📝 China blasts US and Taiwan statements on 37th anniversary of Tiananmen Square military crackdown
item.description: Rubio said on Wednesday that Beijing's censorship could not erase memories of the military assault.
